resources.string: Snapy Metrics Collection: active app habits, screen time and reels count around your camera.

Snapy Metrics Collection reads foreground app context to calculate real-time screen habits, count short-form swipes (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Snapchat, TikTok and others), and power the ambient camera halo ring. It also lets Snapy execute voice-directed navigation (Back, Home, Recents). All processing is strictly on-device; Snapy never reads personal messages, keystrokes, or screen contents. When you turn on a hard reel limit, Snapy presses Back only while that app\'s short-video feed is on screen, so the rest of the app keeps working. If you set Snapy as the accessibility shortcut, holding both volume keys opens Snapy (Android\'s shortcut; Snapy does not read your key presses).
